column1: Broil the broccoli and set aside to add at the end.
Brown the chicken about 3 minutes per side, then set aside.
Cook the red pepper and set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and set aside.
Cook the white parts of the spring onion until they begin to brown.
Add the rice and toast it.
Add the teriyaki marinade first, then the broth a spoonful at a time. When a spoon dragged through the rice leaves a path that doesn't fill with liquid, add more. Continue for 18 minutes.
Mix the chicken, mushrooms, red pepper and broccoli back in.
Serve in bowls topped with sesame seeds and the green parts of the spring onion.
